title: [ConduitOS P0] Bound normal Patchbay publication Commit without weakening Face/Show admission
body:
Parent: #5356, under #6175. Current development acceptance blocker; distinct from closed #6213's graph-selection Commit repair and from #6311/#6317's native preemption contract/mechanism.

Integration [40011260819](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/actions/runs/40011260819), x86_64 job [120626433533](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/actions/runs/40011260819/job/120626433533), source `61b3410c412eed09c62a0499514ac9e85c07e793`: 23 other jobs passed. Actual [diagnostic artifact 12530852342](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/actions/runs/40011260819/artifacts/12530852342) contains source-bound journey manifest, serial, QMP and screenshots. Manifest ISO SHA256 is `c6d6e98dd3b8ce4aee1f9b93f562becdf86109d20173e9ea2c12b27848651246`.

The normal journey reaches Patchbay diagram and Gear details. Later serial records report `request=Some(Commit) detail=Ok(Fault(WorkExhausted)) entries_interrupts_preemptions=Some((4496, 219, 1))`, followed by `operation=patchbay-publish slot=Some(2) refusal=Application`, region revocation and `native-body-kernel-boundary-refused`. The collector subsequently reports `patchbay-action-timeout`. This proves a guest bounded-work refusal preceding the timeout; it does not identify the single most expensive suboperation or calibrated CPU time. Guest watchdog refusal and harness SIGKILL after failure are separate events.

The failing tree already includes `900fc874d` (merged via #6301), which removed one outer Face validation and redundant resident matching scans. The normal transport still does not preflight `PatchbayPublish`. Commit includes framing/inflate, typed decode, canonical Face/Show validation, contribution matching and publication replacement. `MaskShow::validate` currently reaches two internal Face validations. Existing finite graph projection chunks alone did not establish that this complete publication fits a native entry.

Acceptance:
- Preserve the exact original negative evidence and identify the responsible publication work from source and measured native phases.
- Stage the responsible work through the existing correlated Application owner and bounded transport, retaining exact immutable command bytes, slot/target/revision/Body/Face/Mask/Show identity and finite storage. No publication becomes available before all original semantic and authority checks pass. Preserve one-use Show consumption and prior-publication revocation on invalid replacement.
- Retain terminal quarantine on actual entry faults; refuse stale, partial, duplicate, reordered, mismatched and over-bound phases. Do not retry an effect after failure, renew a logical-operation grant through transport phases, or add parallel application/request authority.
- Do not increase the RTC grant, heap/arena, collector timeout or host retries to conceal the failure. Do not weaken Face/Mask/Show validation or substitute Root execution/native fallback. #6311/#6317 keep their separate preemption obligations.
- Meaningful focused tests prove staged ownership/order/atomic visibility, original canonical refusal parity and bounded resource behavior. Then retain a fresh normal PROFILE QEMU journey through the exact Patchbay publication/action and the remaining Stop/return journey, with source/ELF/ISO, Host/Boot, acknowledged Show, serial/QMP and actual screenshots.
- Relevant Candidate and merged-source Integration pass before closure. Keep emulator, physical and stable-publication claims separate.

Ownership: this PR shepherd owns diagnosis/preparation of Application publication only (`application-core` retained state/canonical publication and existing Root transport). No new implementation PR is admitted while the current #6315 queue and failed-development repair are being coordinated. Existing native entry/continuation ownership is preserved.


### Durable original negative packet

[Original packet and independent custody receipt](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/e5f5ab228807acb77f72a185bb04acc6bc2f6f25/docs/audits/evidence/patchbay-publication-refusal-20261023/61b3410c4) are published on origin at `e5f5ab228807acb77f72a185bb04acc6bc2f6f25`. The actual retained Root ELF hash is independently checked against the original build receipt. The ISO hash is manifest-derived; ISO bytes are absent from this packet. Serial, QMP, all retained screenshots and raw job output remain unchanged. This is negative emulator evidence, not a successful current runtime or causal timing proof.


### Checked-Face prerequisite on origin

Prepared on [`prep/6318-bounded-publication-20261023`](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/4cc7afae50ca1b591f0c077a9c4d0401af89ab82) without an additional PR. MaskShow shares one canonical Face validation through an opaque immutable checked borrow; standalone Show/topology validation still validates a naked Face. Full Face suite: 319 passed, 2 existing ignored; strict all-target Clippy, focused formatting and diff checks passed. New tampered-content and unknown-subject controls cover both entrances; the original ordinary-plan InvalidPlan refusal is preserved.

This eliminates one duplicate pass only. It does not prove the complete publication deadline, cumulative operation admission, native runtime or full journey. All original acceptance obligations remain open. A guarded normal PROFILE build and retained-image journey runner is prepared; it waits for the current native proof owner to release its cache and sufficient root/tmp headroom.


### Normal-product prerequisite experiment (2026-10-23)

At exact clean source `4cc7afae50ca1b591f0c077a9c4d0401af89ab82` (parent `643c7649f0e33ba12653b0a4a98c4bea367cbad9`), the supported normal native Make build and retained-image `verify --journey` both exited zero on the first attempt. Independent review verified actual ELF/ISO/source/build/profile bindings, the 24-step journey, all 54 PNGs, checked-source inspection and typed existing-draft refusal.

Original images, ELF, raw logs, manifests, runner, screenshots and audit are retained with per-file hashes: [full experiment packet](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/a8a2a73df57a2972ab25c0eced5e21292feb1fdf/docs/audits/evidence/patchbay-publication-prerequisite-20261023/4cc7afae5). The evidence branch is separate from the implementation preparation branch, and no PR was added to the queue.

This one run does not establish the earlier WorkExhausted root cause or complete this issue. It tests only reuse of one immutable checked Face borrow, without weakening validation. It excludes subsequently merged #6315 / dev3306. Staged bounded publication and preserved cumulative logical grant, current-head Candidate/Integration, and all stated acceptance requirements remain outstanding. No quantum/heap/timeout increase, retry, physical/DMA or stable acceptance claim is added.


## Current Patchbay entry refusal (2026-10-24 UTC)

Fresh current-tree recurrence confirms this P0 remains the normal-product acceptance blocker. All original staged ownership, nonrenewing admitted logical grant, semantic/refusal parity and normal native journey obligations remain.

Candidate40049075388 at source455aaf0a33a5dddf739935003e77b5da2c3788ac (actual preview6975a29c2fe879e3e29d65ae1cbcd3f5f724513b; identical tree89e5e3a75cde6d6edb936cd88771f969c4bb14e5) has a failed x86_64 job120738184105. The normal guest reaches Patchbay, then `Commit` request4496 returns `Fault(WorkExhausted)` during `patchbay-publish` slot2; protected regions revoke and the later harness wait reports `patchbay-action-timeout`. This is the existing ready P0 #6318, rather than evidence that increasing a collector timeout would help. The earlier duplicate-image collector is not reached in this run.

[Immutable current negative packet](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/a30d210e0cccf6caf7fa752556d83703b6fe2a31/docs/audits/evidence/native-application-current-refusal-20261024/6975a29c2) retains the actual10,331,096-byte diagnostics ZIP, raw214,430-byte job log, all35 member hashes, actual Root ELF/build joins and21 checkpoint PNG/pixel hashes. The ISO is identified only by its manifests; original ISO bytes are absent. The precise expensive Commit subphase is not established. No new execution, collector runtime acceptance, full Candidate/Integration or issue closure is claimed.


## Current omnibus admission (2026-10-24 UTC)

The checked-Face prerequisite is now admitted in PR #6339: one immutable checked Face removes a duplicate canonical validation pass inside MaskShow without weakening standalone validation or refusal parity. Full Face319 tests and strict lint passed at parentEAC; the complete Face tree is unchanged at currentd677. This does not implement the staged publication mechanism or establish the precise expensive native subphase.

Before phased production entry, the existing Application owner still needs a selected cumulative policy and admitted backing, one retained logical envelope/immutable command digest, accounted interrupt-source correspondence, and finite phase/turn bounds including zero-interrupt yields. Current transport sequences change per entry and the Draft64RTC allowance resets each entry; merely splitting Preflight/Commit would renew grants. Native entry faults must stay terminal. All original semantic, authority, atomic visibility and normal native journey obligations remain open.

Current delivery source is `d677b25383b22ca2911f1ec49936ca7b4a3c86ee` in existing PR #6339, with fresh [Candidate40054154999](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/actions/runs/40054154999). No additional PR was opened. [Current registry repair, exact positive test and preflight proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/d43f2818a0143dcdb81ee319ee11c975a578f5cc/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-lock-registry-20261024/d677b2538); [source-qualified production/Face proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/dc6cdb60a0214d50c05b3396b0f862c02e0354d7/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-final-20261024/eacbd8350). Full exact-head Candidate, actual dev delivery, applicable Integration and final scoped audits remain required; no issue closure from these local checks.


## Successful dev baseline at dd3 (not full issue acceptance)

Full Integration40049499201 at `dd3cdb41f7a0320658e0c5c00d458db32e5adf56` passed25jobs. Its actual x86 product completed the24-step normal journey through Patchbay publication/action, Stop, Home and re-entry. The [immutable original archive and independent audit](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/983644115f2317bdf1494bad38ba225630d6d90d/docs/audits/evidence/dev-native-baseline-20261024/dd3cdb41f) verify49receiptfiles, actualRoot/ISO/build/boot,23lifecycle records/3ACKs and27PNG pixel/serial-prefix joins. The older455 WorkExhausted packet remains valid: a successful run does not establish causal elimination of the monolithic publication budget risk. This baseline does not include the checked-Face prerequisite or duplicate-image collector repair. Full phased publication, one cumulatively admitted logical grant, adversarial phase/refusal coverage and exact accepted execution remain incomplete; #6318 stays open.
